data source: state ∝ 2018 commercial energy use within the census division (tables/V_state_weights.csv, EIA SEDS); construction year uniform within the YRCONC period; edition = newest with year_in_force <= year (tables/V_states.csv); renovated systems re-dated over [max(2000, period start), 2018]
parameter-draw method: drawn per building per imputation; the state tables are treated as fixed administrative counts (no parameter draw)
replaces: division median at the period midpoint (fixed values)

data source: linkage type all / none / partial and per-class linked-given-declared rates from the 37 census graphs with data (tables/R_linkage_graphs.csv, R_linkage_classes.csv)
parameter-draw method: proper imputation: each imputation refits the type and class rates on a bootstrap resample of the 45 graphs and draws rare-class rates (< 5 declarations) from Beta(1 + linked, 1 + unlinked); type and class linkage then drawn per building
replaces: one linked share r = 0.627 for every building

data source: 2018 commercial AMI share of the building's drawn state (tables/L_ami_states.csv, EIA-861)
parameter-draw method: drawn per building per imputation; the AMI shares are treated as fixed administrative counts

data source: survey: EMCS with heating or cooling control (BAS route) or SMRTTHRM = 1 (smart thermostat); otherwise none
replaces: every code-required thermostat counted as data

data source: code text: 90.1-2013 §8.4.3 records every 15 min and keeps 36 months (tables/C_clauses.csv C08)
parameter-draw method: read from the code text (no imputation); subject to compliance c

data source: reported donors in the same building type × size class × construction period cell (>= 10 donors; coarser cells otherwise); EMCS, EMCSHT, EMCSCL, EMCSLT, SMRTTHRM, OCSN, DCV, VAV, DOAS, DAYHARV; the BAS block moves together when EMCS was imputed
replaces: EIA's single imputation taken as observed

data source: not imputed: the survey observes the control and the recording layer decides whether its stream counts; the census frequencies define the strict scenario only
